details: Bitcoin has recovered to trade above $83,000, with the broader crypto market also seeing gains, pushing the total market cap to $2.9 trillion. This rebound is attributed to stronger-than-expected US corporate earnings and a sharp decline in oil prices, which have helped ease inflation and interest-rate concerns. US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced significant net inflows of $526.6 million on October 19, though inflows on Tuesday were $23 million. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index is currently in "Greed" territory at 63, indicating a willingness among investors to take on more risk despite broader macroeconomic challenges.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds Over $83K Amid Strong US Earnings, Falling Oil

details: Ethereum developers have scheduled the "Glamsterdam" update for activation on the Hoodi testnet on October 26. This upgrade is designed to significantly increase the network's throughput and improve the efficiency of transaction processing, which could enhance the scalability and performance of the Ethereum blockchain.
title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Update Scheduled for October 26

details: XRP traded above $1.30 on October 20, demonstrating a slight recovery over the past 24 hours despite a 3% weekly decline. This movement occurs in the context of recent Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and US inflation data showing a 3.7% increase in September. Crypto investors are closely monitoring the Fed's upcoming meeting on October 27-28 for further indications on monetary policy.
title: XRP Holds Above $1.30 as Market Awaits Fed's October Decision

details: Bitcoin recorded a strong 42.7% gain in the third quarter of 2026, marking a significant recovery after three consecutive down quarters. This was primarily driven by US Treasury bond purchases which led to lower yields and boosted risk assets. However, uncertainty persists as the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision on October 28 approaches, which is expected to influence ETF flows and overall market sentiment for Q4.
title: Bitcoin Surges 42.7% in Q3, Fed Rate Decision Looms
